PDF Level-Of-Detail Volume Rendering via 3D Textures
Abstract In this paper we present an adaptive approach to volume rendering via 3D textures at arbitrary levels of detail. The algorithm has been designed to enable interactive exploration of large-scale data sets while providing user-adjustable resolution levels.
